thread:
lucy: quick flag  CI debug run for partner-ingest turned on and we see vault transit unwraps logged inside build artifact tarball: gs://ci-artifacts/partner-ingest/2026-06-10/build-842/artifact.tar.gz. header: transit_key:ci-debug-v1 and kms wrap metadata projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap. treating as potential leak.
omar: ugh. which pipeline had debug flag? lucy: partner-ingest pipeline (build-842) had VERBOSE_SECRET_LOGS=true accidentally. nina: that explains plaintext tokens in the artifact. we need immediate containment + rotation.
sec-bot: Alert: vault.transit.unwrap logged in artifact content detected by artifact-monitor (3 matches). Created case SEC-2026-211.
oncall-ops: i can run emergency containment. suggested steps: snapshot artifact, revoke CI runner SA access to artifact bucket, rotate transit_key and partner KMS wrap key, coordinate partner rewrap.
lucy: confirmed artifact snapshot to gs://redwood-quarantine/SEC-2026-211/build-842.tar.gz (readonly). posted sha256 and limited redacted samples to ticket.
omar: triage checklist: 1) confirm which secrets were unwrapped and by which service 2) identify CI runners with VERBOSE_SECRET_LOGS enabled 3) rotate affected transit and KMS wrap keys 4) tighten RBAC for runner SA + partner SA 5) audit retention extension.
nina: quick grep shows three env vars leaked: PARTNER_API_KEY, PARTNER_DB_PASSWORD, INTERNAL_SENTRY_DSN. marking PARTNER_API_KEY as P0.
sec-bot: Recommendation: extend vault & cloudkms audit retention to 365 days while we investigate.
oncall-ops: rotation plan (no downtime expected): - create transit_key:ci-debug-v2 and kms key version partner-wrap-v2 - update vault config to add new key as preferred - run streaming rewrap for artifacts and quarantine rewrapped copies - deploy ingester clients to prefer v2 - revoke decrypt on v1 (do not destroy).
lucy: caution: legal requests we don't modify partner-submitted artifacts until partner agrees to evidence transfer. we'll quarantine and prepare rewrap but wait on partner signoff for destructive ops.
omar: RBAC changes: - remove broad project-level roles from CI runner SA, grant only necessary kms.encrypt for uploads - add condition on partner SA to restrict operations to partner-ingest-bucket origin - remove any roles/owner bindings on key. I'll open infra PR.
nina: CI fix: add a guard in pipeline config to block VERBOSE_SECRET_LOGS=true on any branch matching partner-*; default to false. small PR prepared.
oncall-ops: i'll author runbook and schedule a 2h window for rotation if partner approves. also prepare emergency revoke steps if we detect active exploitation.
partners-team: pinged partner contact and legal. partner acknowledges receipt and requests we hand over redacted samples.
lucy: next actions: - nina to remove debug flag & PR (ETA 30m) - omar to open RBAC PR (ETA 1.5h) - oncall-ops to draft runbook + prepare rotation scripts (ETA 2h) - lucy to keep partner/legal updated and hold destructive ops until approval.
sec-bot: Ticket SEC-2026-211 tracking. Keep updates short in this thread. :lock:
